falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 41 suggests stress peak/near-bottom conditions; a deepening inversion contradicts this by signaling escalating recession risk and credit stress, invalidating the 'HOLD' signal as premature stabilization

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below its 200-day moving average by more than 5% (i.e., 5% buffer break) for 3 consecutive sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed contained drawdown within a correction framework; sustained breakdown below this threshold confirms trend reversal to bear market, making the UNKNOWN/HOLD verdict a failed call
